title: The owner's twenty-second notes: the alien-language voice synced from seiyu_voice, flavour lines speak less, sectors move themselves on, gunship rounds fly on after the seat, the Lancer's burn on the face and the ground, holes come back as walls, a lander's footprint from its body, hundreds of bodies, the Heptapod walks the floor and fires
context: Owner, 2026-10-05 (on ff7a2f9a): 1) new voices for the alien-language announcement, two lines made in ~/Dev/seiyu_voice, integrate and sync both projects; 2) drop 'Are you having fun keeping score?'; 3) the Lancer's burn offset on walls, staying too long, not on the ground; 4) the tank always stuck in the bottleneck to the mortar's lander (HUGIN), bumping an unseen obstacle; 5) 'pimp your ride' said before the garage exists; 6) less flavour and encouragement, key announcements and nukes always; 7) a nuke or the gunship's guns must not be cancelled by switching seats; 8) a shell's hole should be mended as a wall or gate, not rock; 9) hundreds of bodies, not dozens, especially with the auto gunship; 10) the Heptapod glides, flies over walls and never settles to fire; 11) sector 5: a dead moment, no enemies, no resolution after a nuke took the far tremor site; 12) sector 6: SOL control did not work after using SOL by hand; 13) the sector progression seems broken.
outcome: 1, 2) In seiyu_voice (cdcae4e): lab_96 and lab_98 promoted into a new trigger vibration_study (lab_97 left in the lab), the soft-ones line already replaced by the operator, exported (157 lines, 49 triggers) and imported; the game says vibration_study_01 with the study brief's first line and _02 with its third (a brief's later lines, id#n, skip the rests and wait their turn). 5) build_garage's paint lines play only at paint_pad, raised when the shop opens. 6) VOICE_FLAVOR (soft ones, stampede, RAM milestones, good hit, idle, board, print and build chatter, repair chatter, shells, hull rebuilt, array): 35% of their moments and 90 s apart at least; a passed-over moment rests as if said. 3) lance-burn: a wall stamp stands on the face (the beam's reverse laid level, lifted off the floor), a ground stamp lies on the ground; life 20 -> 7 s. 4) story-base solidAt builds a structure's footprint from its bulky parts near the ground (8% of the largest part's volume), so a lander's splayed legs no longer wall its lane. 7) dismountGunship keeps rounds in the air; the optic's tracers fly on (fade); landGunshipRounds lands them and a released MK-9 with nobody seated, auto or not. 8) story-base patchWall: a mended hole that was rock gets a kit wall segment copied from the nearest and turned about the planet's centre onto the cell, drawn as floor under it. 9) SECTOR_TIMING soft x2 from sector 1, +1 a sector, to x8, aliveBudget 2500; the auto gunship's swell 2 and budget 3500. 10) heptapod stepA6: an open(pos) ground (never rock), an approach that cannot close fires from where it stands when in range, `moving` drives the legs; td-tab places it on the floor or its berth's top, not the wall roof everywhere. 11, 13) sector-run: after SECTOR_TIMING.stall (20 s) with no kill, wave or breach opening, the next wave releases past the budget, a breach whose waves are out collapses with its queue stuck, and bodies left no longer hold SECURE; an open side breach's lane is not mended until its waves are out (it had stranded its bodies). 12) a pass laid while SOL is up lifts the old pass's beam and contacts, and a seated player is re-seated for it.
alternatives: Eliminating the Heptapod: the owner's fallback if the walk cannot be fixed; tried first
Despawning stuck bodies to resolve a sector: they count as done instead and stay where they are
evidence: unit tests: voice (flavour, brief order, paint moments), gunship (rounds land after the seat), heptapod (no step onto rock, fires when held, still legs), repair-orders, sectors; npm test, check
Not reproduced in a browser: the HUGIN lane (footprint rule only), sectors 5 and 6 (traced by an investigation, fixed by rule)
